theorems.name: Submission.ble_lintegral_sq_tendsto_of_l2_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (μ : Measure α) (f : α → E) (φ : ℕ → α → E), MemLp f 2 μ → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (φ j) μ) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖φ j x - f x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖φ j x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ))
